chapter.verse: Gunkuang sung Jesu a tun ciangin galkhat lam kanin ama' tenna khua ah pai hi.

En un, mi kimkhat in lupna tunga kisial pumzaw mi khat Jesu' kiangah paipih uh hi. Jesu in tua mite' upna a muh ciangin pumzawpa' kiangah, “Ka ta aw, lungnuam in. Na mawhnate hong kimaisak hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin, en un, laisiamte amaumah kiho uh a, “Hih pa in Pasian daisak tazen!” ci uh hi.
Jesu in tua mite' ngaihsut thu thei ahih manin, “Bang hangin na lungsim sung uhah thusia ngaihsun na hi uh hiam?
‘Na mawhnate hong kimaisak hi,’ cih ding leh, ‘Tho inla lampai in,’ cih ding, koi baihzaw ahi hiam?
Ahi zongin leitung ah Mihing' Tapa in mawhmaisak nading hihtheihna thu nei cih na theih nadingun”—a cih kawmin pumzaw mipa' kiangah—“Tho inla na lupna la-in na inn ah ciah in,” ci hi.
Tua mipa zong tho-in a inn ah ciah hi.
Mihonpi in a muh ciangin lau uh a, hih bang hihtheihna thu mihingte' tungah a pia Pasian phat uh hi.
Tua mun pan Jesu paisuak a, siahdong buk sunga tu Matthew kici mi khat a muh ciangin, “Hong zui in,” ci hi. Tua mipa zong dingto-in Jesu zui hi.
Inn sungah Jesu anne-in a tut laitak, en un, siahdongte leh mawhneite tampi hong pai-in Jesu leh a nungzuite tawh an nekhawm uh hi.
Pharisee-te in a muh ciangin Jesu' nungzuite kiangah, “Bang hangin na syapa un siahdongte leh mawhneite tawh an nekhawm ahi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Tua thu Jesu in a zak ciangin, “Cidamte zatui siampu kisam lo uh a, cinate bek kisam uh hi.
Pai unla, ‘Biakpiakna sangin thukhualna ka deihzaw hi,’ cih thu a khiatna va kan un. A hang pen midikte a sam ding hilo, mawhneite a sam dingin hong pai ka hi hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin John' nungzuite Jesu' kiangah hong pai uh a, “Kote leh Pharisee-te in an tang napi-in bang hangin nangma' nungzuite in an tang lo uh ahi hiam?” ci uh hi.

Jesu in tua mite hih bangin dawng hi: “Zipi tangvalpa a om laisiah mopawisiim lawmlegual teng dahin kapin om thei ding uh hiam? Amau' kiangpan zipi tangvalpa a kipaikhiatpih ding hunlenite hong tung ding a, tua ciangin amau zong an tang ding uh hi.
Kuamah in puansilh a lui khat puanbekno a ton nailo khat tawh phop lo uh hi. A hang pen puansilh a lui panin a phopna kikekkhia ding a, tua a kikekna suksiazaw ding hi.

Tua dan mahin savun-uum lui sungah lengtui thak kithun ngeilo hi. Kithun hileh savun-uum phukham ding a, lengtui thuk bua-in savun-uum zong kisia ding hi. Tua hi a, lengtui thak pen savun-uum thak ah kithunzaw hi. Tua hileh a nihin sauvei kimang hi.”

Hih thute Jesu in a gen laitak, en un, ulian khat hong pai-in Jesu' mai-ah khukdin a, “Ka tanu tu mahin si hi. Ahi zongin nang hong pai-in ama' tungah na khut hong ngaksak in; tua hileh amah hingkik ding hi,” ci hi.
Jesu leh a nungzuite dingto-in ulianpa zui uh hi.
En un, kum sawmlenih tawntung siluang natna a vei numei khat in Jesu' nung nehphei-in a puansilh khaukai va lawng hi.
A hang pen numeinu amahmah kiho-in, “A puansilh lawng bek le-ing zong damna ka ngah ding hi,” ci hi.
Jesu kihei-in numeinu a muh ciangin, “Tanu aw, lungnuam in. Na upna in nang hong damsak khin hi,” ci hi. Tua hunlenai lianin numeinu in damna ngah hi.
Ulianpa' inn ah Jesu pai-in tamngai tumte leh mihonpi gamlum ngeingai a muh ciangin,
“Paikhia un. A hang pen numeino a si hilo-in a ihmu hi bek hi,” ci hi. Tua ciangin mite in amah nuihsan uh hi.
Ahih hangin mihonpi a pusuah khit ciangin inn sungah Jesu lutin numeino' khut len a, numeino zong thoto hi.
Hih thuthang tua gam sung bup kizel hi.
Tua mun pan Jesu paisuak a, khuamulo mi nih in amah zui-in, “David' Tapa aw, kote hong khual in,” ci-in nakpi awng uh hi.
Inn sung a lut ciangin khuamulote gel ama' kiangah pai uh hi. Jesu in tua nihte' kiangah, “Tua bang ahihthei dingin nong um uh hiam?” ci hi. Amau zong, “Topa aw, kong um uh hi,” ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in a mit uh lawnsak a, “Na upna uh bangin note' tungah piang ta hen,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin tuate gel a mit uh kihong hi. Jesu in, “Kidawm un; Hih thupiang kuamah theisak kei un,” ci-in khauhtak kham hi.
Ahih hangin tuate gel paikhia-in tua gam sung bup ah ama' minthanna kizelsak uh hi.
Tuate gel a paikhiat uh ciangin, en un, dawilut a pautheilo mi khat Jesu' kiangah kipaipih hi.
A dawi a kihawlkhiat khit ciangin a pautheilo tua mipa pau hi. Mihonpi in lamdang sa mahmah uh a, “Hih bang dan Israel sungah kimu ngei nailo!” ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Pharisee-te in, “Amah in dawi-uk mangpa' min tawh dawite hawlkhia hi,” ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin khuapi khuata citeng ah Jesu pai-in amau' vengkhawm innte ah thu hilhcian a, kumpigam Lungdamna Thu tangko-in natna leh zawngkhalna namkim damsak hi.
Mihonpi a muh ciangin Jesu in tua mite hehpihhuai sa mahmah hi. A hang pen amaute tuucing omlo tuuhon bangin lungmangin cimawh uh hi.
Tua ciangin a nungzuite' kiangah hih bangin ci hi: “Anlak ding tam napi nasemmi tawm hi.
Tua ahih manin ama' anlakna phual ah nasemmi hong puak nadingin annei Topa' kiangah nakpi thungen un.”
